description: This PHP class defines an abstract base for handling call expressions within Twig's node expression system, including method compilation, argument handling, and reflection-based callables.

classes.name: CallExpression
classes.description: An abstract class defining how call expressions are compiled and executed within Twig templates, handling various callable types and argument extraction.

methods.name: compileCallable
methods.description: Prepares the callable source code for the node, handling strings, arrays, and extension class calls, and compiling arguments.

methods.name: compileArguments
methods.description: Generates code for calling a function or method, including environment, context, and additional arguments.

methods.name: getArguments
methods.description: Deprecated method for retrieving arguments, now replaced by CallableArgumentsExtractor.

methods.name: normalizeName
methods.description: Deprecated method for normalizing argument names to lowercase snake_case.

methods.name: getCallableParameters
methods.description: Reflects on a callable to determine its parameters, especially for variadic functions.

methods.name: reflectCallable
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a ReflectionCallable instance to analyze callables.

methods.name: getTwigCallable
methods.description: Overrides the Twig callable based on node attributes, used during compilation.
